option_relations.rationale: Uveitic cystoid macular edema is a specific type of uveitis that includes macular edema as a complication or manifestation.
Anastrozole-associated uveitis with cystoid macular edema is a specific type of uveitis where anastrozole is the suspected etiology and cystoid macular edema is a complication/manifestation.
Drug-induced uveitis (anastrozole) is a specific type of uveitis where anastrozole is the suspected etiology.
Idiopathic uveitis with cystoid macular edema is a specific type of uveitis where the cause is unknown and cystoid macular edema is a complication/manifestation.
